news.headline: CEO Joe Burnett Cash-Exercises 12,517 Options at $3.47 and Holds Every Share
news.summary: In a Form 4 filed September 3 for a September 2 transaction, CEO and President Joseph Burnett exercised 12,517 stock options at $3.47, paid the exercise price in cash and retained all resulting shares rather than doing a cashless sell-to-cover, leaving 61,887 options outstanding.

news.headline: Partner uniQure Submits AMT-130 BLA to FDA and MAA to UK MHRA for Huntington's Disease
news.summary: uniQure submitted a Biologics License Application to the FDA seeking accelerated approval of AMT-130 (ifezuntirgene inilparvovec) with a Priority Review request, plus a parallel Marketing Authorisation Application to the UK MHRA, based on three-year Phase I/II data. Every patient in those studies was dosed through the ClearPoint Neuro Navigation System and SmartFlow cannula, making this the first BLA built on ClearPoint's delivery platform in a large chronic indication.

news.headline: MAK Capital Group Discloses 7.8% Passive Stake in ClearPoint Neuro via Schedule 13G/A
news.summary: MAK Capital Fund LP and MAK Capital One LLC reported 2,375,861 CLPT shares as of June 30, 2026, or 7.8% of shares outstanding, up from 1,901,489 shares (6.3%) disclosed on May 15. Filed nine days after the post-earnings selloff, the larger passive position points to institutional accumulation into the weakness, alongside BlackRock's 7.1% 13G/A filed July 27.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Unveils Five-Pillar Strategy Targeting $500M in Annual Revenue
news.summary: Alongside the Q2 miss, management presented a long-term strategy aiming at $500M in annual revenue built on five pillars: cell and gene therapy delivery, the newly acquired ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories preclinical site in Torrey Pines, the SONOCARE focused-ultrasound partnership, a cranial robot in development and Harmony 1.0 control software. Management cited 175+ active centers and 60+ pharma partners.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Reports Q2 2026 Revenue of $10.9M (+18%), Misses Estimates and Cuts FY Guidance to $48-52M
news.summary: Q2 revenue rose 18% to $10.88M but landed roughly $1.8M below consensus, with neurosurgery navigation and therapy up 62% while biologics and drug delivery fell 15% on fewer products shipped for new trial starts. Cash fell to $29.4M from $45.9M at year-end, and FY2026 guidance was cut from $52-56M to $48-52M.

news.headline: Partner Aspen Neuroscience Receives FDA RMAT Designation for Parkinson's Cell Therapy Delivered via ClearPoint's Platform
news.summary: The FDA granted Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy designation to Aspen Neuroscience's sasineprocel (ANPD001), an autologous dopaminergic cell therapy for Parkinson's disease delivered in every case via the ClearPoint Navigation System and SmartFlow cannula in the Phase I/IIa ASPIRO trial. RMAT status gives Aspen early, frequent FDA interaction and potential eligibility for priority review and accelerated approval, adding a third active gene/cell-therapy partner pathway (with uniQure and EpilepsyGTx) built on ClearPoint's delivery platform.

catalysts.label: uniQure presents four-year AMT-130 follow-up data
catalysts.detail: uniQure has guided to topline four-year safety and efficacy data on all 24 patients from the first two AMT-130 cohorts, confirmed still pending in a September 10 STAT News preview. Every one of those patients was dosed through ClearPoint's SmartFlow cannula and navigation system, so durability of the 75% progression-slowing signal seen at three years is the closest available read on the delivery platform performing over multiple years and the next major stock-moving event for CLPT.

catalysts.label: FDA 60-day filing review decides acceptance and Priority Review for the AMT-130 BLA
catalysts.detail: uniQure submitted the AMT-130 BLA on September 2, 2026 with a Priority Review request, which would cut the FDA review clock from ten months to roughly six. Within the standard 60-day filing review, due around early November, the FDA will confirm whether the application is accepted and whether Priority Review is granted.

catalysts.label: UK MHRA review of the AMT-130 Marketing Authorisation Application
catalysts.detail: uniQure filed a parallel MAA with the UK MHRA on September 2, 2026. A UK validation and subsequent review would extend ClearPoint's delivery platform into a second, ex-US commercial channel alongside the US accelerated-approval pathway.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings: biologics back to growth and cash-burn check
catalysts.detail: Management said the CAL preclinical facility should return the biologics and drug delivery segment, down 15% to $4.0M in Q2, to growth in Q3. With cash at $29.4M and opex up sharply year over year, investors will watch whether opex growth moderates or a capital raise moves onto the table. No date has been announced yet.

catalysts.label: Further partner BLA filings flagged on the Q2 call
catalysts.detail: Management stated that multiple biopharma partners have recently received positive FDA feedback on potential BLA submissions and that additional cell and gene therapies should become commercially available by the end of 2027. Each partner filing beyond uniQure widens the base of recurring per-procedure delivery revenue.

catalysts.label: Aspen Neuroscience post-RMAT FDA engagement for sasineprocel
catalysts.detail: Following the July 31, 2026 RMAT designation, Aspen Neuroscience gains early and frequent FDA interaction and potential eligibility for priority review or accelerated approval for its ClearPoint-delivered Parkinson's cell therapy. Any resulting alignment on a registrational pathway would add a third biopharma partner, alongside uniQure and EpilepsyGTx, moving toward a filing built on ClearPoint's delivery platform.

catalysts.label: EpilepsyGTx EPY201 Phase 1/2a start
catalysts.detail: EpilepsyGTx selected ClearPoint's SmartFlow cannula and navigation system for a first-in-human Phase I/IIa trial of EPY201 in focal refractory epilepsy, slated to enter human studies in 2026. No first-patient-dosed update has been reported yet.

catalysts.label: Partner trial ramp and roughly 10 data readouts
catalysts.detail: Management guided to 10-15 clinical trials using ClearPoint technology enrolling patients over the next 18 months, plus roughly 10 partner data readouts, the core driver of the biologics and drug-delivery revenue line.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 confirmatory Phase 3 trial start
catalysts.detail: The FDA's agreement to accept a BLA under accelerated approval is contingent on uniQure running a prospective, randomized confirmatory trial, again requiring ClearPoint's navigation system and SmartFlow cannula for every dosing.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA accelerated-approval decision on AMT-130
catalysts.detail: With the BLA filed September 2, 2026 and Priority Review requested, an FDA decision on the first Huntington's gene therapy could arrive as early as the first half of 2027 if Priority Review is granted, or in late 2027 under standard review.

pulse: ClearPoint's dealflow remains anchored by the September 2 uniQure AMT-130 BLA/UK MAA submission and CEO Joe Burnett's cash option exercise (no shares sold) on September 3, with no material company news since as of September 11; the still-pending four-year AMT-130 data - guided for before month-end per a September 10 STAT News preview - is the next major stock-moving event given ClearPoint's platform is central to AMT-130 delivery. Beneath that headline, ClearPoint's partner base keeps widening: Aspen Neuroscience's July 31 RMAT designation for its ClearPoint-delivered Parkinson's cell therapy adds a third active gene/cell-therapy pathway alongside uniQure and EpilepsyGTx, even as near-term device revenue growth has decelerated following August's guidance cut to $48-52M. Institutional positioning firmed into the summer selloff, with MAK Capital's stake rising to 7.8% by mid-August alongside BlackRock's 7.1% filing, while the November Q3 print is the next hard checkpoint on cash burn against a $29.4M cash balance.
